native_components.name: Birthday / Date console
native_components.description: Review prototype: tapping the date module cycles example states with a 180 ms dissolve. This is not free date input. Day, month, year remain native text properties over a decoration-only raster housing. Production intent: use an accessible native wheel or typed platform date-entry interface, with persistent labels and announced values. Validate a complete committed calendar date; reject impossible and future dates, handle leap years, and compare against the exact 18th-birthday boundary in the relevant local calendar (never raw year subtraction or UTC instant conversion). Never auto-advance. Under-18 cannot continue. Birthday is self-declared, not age/identity verification. Reduced motion is stationary.
